{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check if any revenue values are invalid
print("Invalid revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check conversion rate by channel
email_converted = completed_orders[completed_orders['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_converted = completed_orders[completed_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

effect = email_converted - paid_search_converted

print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_converted:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_converted:.4f}")
print(f"Effect (email - paid_search): {effect:.4f}")"}
